title: Healing Herbal Kenyan Chicken Wrap
description: A savory and shattering Kenyan dish featuring chicken, herbs, and blue food coloring, wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, perfect for post-workout meals with anti-inflammatory benefits.
instructions: Preheat a steamer basket over boiling water.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, blue food coloring, turmeric, ginger, garlic, and salt.
Brush the coconut oil onto the banana leaves.
Place a quarter of the chicken mixture onto the center of each banana leaf.
Fold the leaves over the filling to form a tight package.
Place the packages in the steamer basket.
Cover the steamer and steam for 20 minutes.
Remove the packages from the steamer and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chicken wraps hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
